title: Salesforce and Agentforce
summary: Setting up or cleaning up your Salesforce org, and building Agentforce agents that answer customer questions from your own knowledge base.
audience: For companies with 10 to 200 staff that use Salesforce or are about to.
body: Often Salesforce was set up once and never maintained, and the team ends up working in spreadsheets next to it.
I start with an audit, remove what nobody uses and rebuild the processes that matter. Where it saves real time, I add an Agentforce agent.
deliverables: An Agentforce agent on your knowledge base

title: AI automation
summary: Automating intake, triage and reporting, with logging and a person who can step in when needed.
audience: For teams that spend hours each week on manual intake, sorting or reporting.
body: We pick one workflow, measure how long it takes now, and automate it. Every step is logged and a person can take over at any point.
Once it works and the numbers are clear, you decide whether to do the next one.
deliverables: A workflow analysis with time baseline
A working automation in your own tools
A GDPR check on the data involved

title: Compliance
summary: CE marking and Radio Equipment Directive files for products, and GDPR documentation for the way you handle personal data.
audience: For manufacturers selling in the EU, and any company that processes personal data.
body: CE marking, the Radio Equipment Directive and GDPR are clear on paper but take a lot of work in practice.
I compare your situation with the rules that apply, then build the file with you, written so that an auditor can follow it.
deliverables: CE / RED technical file and Declaration of Conformity
Privacy statement, records of processing, DPIA
A review of cookies and consent

title: Buy-and-build
summary: Growth through acquisition: defining the platform company, finding and assessing targets, and structuring the deals.
audience: For owners and investors who want to grow through acquisitions.
body: Growth through acquisition. We help define the platform company, find and assess targets, and structure the deals.
We also speed up the strategy by wrapping: acquiring smaller competitors and merging them into the platform, so scale and margin grow faster than they would organically.
deliverables: A definition of the platform company
A search and assessment of targets
Wrapping smaller competitors into the platform
